name: Magic Studio storyboard master template

page.note: one page == one open-book spread (left page x 0-800, right page x 800-1600)

workflow: scene_fill.py studio-template.designcraft scene.json out.designcraft  (duplicates the scene spread and fills every label)
labels are object.label values; find with object.findByLabel; text frames take story.setText, picture frames place.load + place.drop + object.fit
